name: The Cursed Cloak
source:
When a wolf tears off your special red cloak, a wicked curse threatens to consume you. Will you find your happily ever after... or fall to its power?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Cursed_Cloak]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当狼撕下你特殊的红色斗篷时，邪恶的诅咒就会威胁要吞噬你。你会找到你的幸福吗……还是会屈服于它的力量？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Cursed_Cloak]Choices Wikia[/url]]
